scenarios.title: One tap on a Vault helm with the head slot empty: worn within minutes, gone from the Vault, nothing dropped
scenarios.pending_reason: the runner has no setup for a vault record (Items where=vault: give the item, read its bytes with `item full`, `item vault` it, write the record into the hero's vault store) nor for a worn start item (where=body), and does not substitute the record id into trigger.api bodies ({{vault.1}}); the bot side, the order API and the offline tests are done (docs/vault.md, Equip)
scenarios.provenance: SETUP (CHEATED, mechanics only): level 14 and the given items by the debug give verb; the vault record is made from a given item. Not evidence about balance or parity.
scenarios.notes: Paladin and Sorceress both wear a helm (cap, S). The vault record leaves the live state (kept): U, needs the vault observer.

assert.why: it is not left in the backpack
the bot logged the verified equip
